problemSolution.title: WhatsApp inquiries grow faster than your ability to answer them
problemSolution.subtitle: Every agency runs into the same operational bottlenecks. ReservaNex solves them from a single place.

items.problem: Inquiries scattered across different phones with no organized history.
items.solution: A single inbox with every conversation, its contact and the associated listing.

items.problem: Your team answers the same questions about location, capacity or price over and over.
items.solution: AI answers automatically using the real information you loaded for each listing.

items.problem: No one is quite sure who's handling each chat.
items.solution: Assignable conversations: unclaimed chats stay visible to the whole team, assigned ones are clear to everyone.

items.problem: Bookings and pre-bookings get coordinated through loose messages and details get lost along the way.
items.solution: Bookings with status, temporary availability holds and human confirmation before closing.

items.problem: Listing information lives scattered across spreadsheets, loose photos and the team's memory.
items.solution: Centralized property records with photos, attributes and custom data.

items.problem: It's hard to combine the speed of a bot with a person's judgment.
items.solution: AI handles it first and hands off to a person whenever the conversation calls for it.

howItWorks.title: From inquiry to booking, in one continuous flow
howItWorks.subtitle: ReservaNex connects WhatsApp, artificial intelligence and your sales team in a single process.

faq.title: Everything you need to know before getting started

items.question: What is ReservaNex?
items.answer: It's a CRM for real estate agencies that centralizes WhatsApp inquiries, answers them with AI when appropriate, and organizes contacts, listings and bookings in one place.

items.question: Does ReservaNex replace front-desk agents?
items.answer: No. AI handles initial inquiries and frequent questions, but your team keeps control over sensitive decisions and can take over any conversation whenever needed.

items.question: How does it connect to WhatsApp?
items.answer: ReservaNex connects through the WhatsApp Cloud API, the official business messaging channel, using your agency's own number.

items.question: Can the AI answer questions about my listings?
items.answer: Yes. The AI answers using exclusively the information you loaded: location, capacity, description, price and availability.

items.question: Can I step into a conversation manually?
items.answer: Yes. Any authorized member of your team can take control of a conversation the moment they need to.

items.question: Can I assign chats to different people?
items.answer: Yes. Conversations can be assigned to a specific agent or left available for anyone on the team to pick up.

items.question: Does it work for short-term rentals and sales?
items.answer: Yes. ReservaNex is built for both short-term rental operations and traditional sales and long-term rentals.

items.question: Can I manage bookings?
items.answer: Yes. You can create bookings tied to a conversation, hold availability, and confirm them from your team.

items.question: How much does it cost?
items.answer: Pricing depends on the size of your operation: number of users, conversation volume and the features you need. Reach out and we'll put together a plan for you.

items.question: Is it available in multiple languages?
items.answer: Yes. The CRM and this website are available in Spanish, Portuguese and English.

items.question: Do I need to install any software?
items.answer: No. ReservaNex runs entirely in the browser, with no additional installs.

items.question: How do I request a demo?
items.answer: Message us on WhatsApp or fill out the contact form and we'll set up a demo with your team.

privacyPage.intro: This policy describes, in general terms, how ReservaNex handles information received through this website and the product.

sections.heading: What information we collect
sections.body: Through the contact form, we collect the data you voluntarily submit: name, company, country, WhatsApp number, email, approximate number of listings, and your message.

sections.heading: How we use the information
sections.body: We use this data exclusively to respond to your inquiry and, together with your team, evaluate whether ReservaNex fits your operation.

sections.heading: Who we share information with
sections.body: We don't sell or hand off your information to third parties. Only ReservaNex staff responsible for handling business inquiries use it.

sections.heading: How we protect information
sections.body: We apply reasonable security practices to protect the data you share with us, both in transit and at rest.

sections.heading: Your rights
sections.body: You can request, at any time, to access, correct or delete the information you shared with us by reaching out through the contact channels on this site.
